name: Jon D. Fox
summary: Jon D. Fox (April 22, 1947 – February 11, 2018) was an American Republican politician. He served as a  member of Pennsylvania House of Representatives from 1985 to 1992 before being elected to the Montgomery County Board of Commissioners (1992–1995). His final political role was as a member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Pennsylvania between 1995 and 1999.
